content.short: Hold your own keys across many chains with CoinEx Wallet, which adds aggregated swaps, staking and a dapp browser.
content.description: CoinEx Wallet is separate from the CoinEx trading account. Users hold their own keys and manage coins and tokens on Ethereum, Solana, Polkadot and Cosmos networks, among others. In-app swaps aggregate several DEXs for better rates. Mainstream assets can be staked from the same screen, and a built-in browser opens dapps without an extension. NFTs are supported alongside regular tokens. It supports 55+ coins and more than a million tokens, including Sei, and CoinEx also offers CoinEx Vault, a self-custody wallet built for businesses.
content.meta: Self-custody wallet from CoinEx with aggregated swaps, staking, NFTs and a dapp browser. Explore CoinEx Wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
